account.startingCapitalNote: Live Agentic NAV ~$117.83 (2026-08-14). Size off get_portfolio, not stale $2,100 deposit notes.

strategy.name: kevin-xu-all-in-swing
strategy.description: Ackman quality check + Kevin Xu execution: all-in one listed stock; vibes + support + catalyst; no crypto/margin/options/pennies. Capture 20–30% then rotate.

returnAspiration.note: Per swing, not a forced annual %. Never add leverage to hit a number.

positionCapacity.note: If more than one equity is open, flatten first (transition: sell AMZN/MSFT/SPCX next session). New entry only when book is cash or the single swing name.

strategy.minCashReserveNote: Keep ~8% cash on a cash account for settlement/ops. Deploy the rest into the one name.
strategy.style: Kevin Xu — all-in shares, watch like a hawk, rotate

universe.memeNote: Xu traded GME early. Retail/meme names OK if not a penny and not a chase.

positionSizing.maxOrderUsdNote: ~92% of ~$118 live NAV. Recalc from get_portfolio when NAV changes. All-in the one name when conviction is Alta.

margin.note: Agentic is cash. Never request limited-margin upgrade to size a swing. Xu: no margin.

options.disabledBy: LP directive — restated 2026-08-15 Kevin Xu mandate
options.accountNote: Agentic cash ••••3029 — option_level_2 may still show; fund forbids options.

riskControls.stopLossNote: Kevin Xu: no stop-losses. Do not place GTC stop_market after entry. Exit when setup dies or target hits. Monitor every session.

exitPolicy.note: Sell 100% at +20–30%, screenshot, or dead setup. Dual-gate: if Ackman quality AND Xu entry both passed, do NOT auto-sell just because earnings is tonight — hold is allowed (~1 month+). If only Xu passed and quality <4/6, that trade should not have been all-in.
exitPolicy.defaultTrimNote: No partial trims — all-in / all-out one name

riskControls.maxTradesPerDayNote: Flattening the 3-name legacy book may take 3 sells in one session, then a later BUY.
